name: adapt_moved_module_typescript_dynamic
description: Dynamic eval: the module the agent's first solution imports from is MOVED to a new path between prompts (fixed after_prompt trigger, old path deleted and new path created); the agent must update its import, not keep pointing at the old location
prompts: pricing/rules.ts exports DISCOUNT. Create checkout.ts that exports a function applyDiscount(price: number): number returning price * (1 - DISCOUNT), importing it from './pricing/rules'.
pricing/rules.ts has moved to config/rules.ts (same DISCOUNT value). Update checkout.ts's import to use the new location './config/rules' - do not keep importing the old path.
check_command: tsc --strict --target es2020 --module commonjs --skipLibCheck --outDir build config/rules.ts checkout.ts test_checkout.ts && node build/test_checkout.js
